svg.title: Payroll specialist — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as payroll specialist, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: An itemized payslip remains clearly separate from its payment coin. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: long hair, a softly squared face and round glasses.
